items.description: The actions, in order. label is shown when the button expands and is always its accessible name. With doneLabel, a successful onSelect turns the icon into a check and the label into that word, such as "Archived". Return false or reject to skip it; a promise keeps the button busy until it settles.

label.description: Accessible name of the toolbar, such as "Message actions".

size.description: Button height of 28 or 36px, with 14 or 16px icons.

defaultExpanded.description: Id of the action whose label shows at rest, usually the primary one. One action is always expanded: pointing at or focusing another moves the expansion there, and the group returns to this one when the pointer and focus leave.

onAction.description: Called with the item id whenever an action runs, before the item's own onSelect.

confirmDuration.description: How long the confirmation stays, in milliseconds.
